name: OptMem
description: OptMem is a permanent memory system for AI agents: a 426-token prompt plus a single-file Python script, plug and play. The installer prints a Memory block that you paste at the top of your agent's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, and a memo command-line tool manages everything else from there. Memories are stored append-only in a log, with a rebuildable binary-tree of one-line summaries used for navigation and compression, so nothing is ever edited or deleted and position is identity. The tool has no dependencies and never runs in the background: wake prints the memory at session start, note records a one-line memory, nap answers merges that came due, and recall searches every memory word for word.
highlights: 426-token prompt plus one-file Python script, installed with a single curl command
Append-only memory log with a rebuildable binary-tree of summaries
Fixed-width records make position identity, so lookups are single seeks
Six commands: wake, note, nap, recall, zoom, forget — nothing runs in the background
Zero dependencies; memory store relocatable via $MEMORY_DIR
curatorNote: Most agent-memory projects are databases that need infrastructure; OptMem collapses the whole idea to a prompt and a script you can paste into any agent config. The fixed-width record design and rebuildable summary tree are an unusually elegant answer to the context-compaction problem.
